procedure_text: 步骤a:取1.1mol(134.2g)三氟乙醇钠,1.2mol(28.8g)氢氧化锂,1.0mol(318g)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸甲酯(化合物I),1000mL N,N-二甲基甲酰胺加入到反应器中，然后30℃保温5小时后，将反应液中的N，N-二甲基甲酰胺减压蒸除后，将残液加入300mL水中，用35％的盐酸调pH至弱酸性，冷却结晶，过滤，水洗，干燥得化合物II，称重得318.3g，收率92％。
procedure_summary: Sodium trifluoroethoxide, lithium hydroxide and the bromomethyl methanesulfonylbenzoate ester were charged into a reactor with N,N-dimethylformamide and held with warming. The solvent was distilled off under reduced pressure, the residue was taken into water and acidified, and the product crystallised on cooling and was filtered, washed with water and dried to give compound II.

procedure_text: 步骤b：取1mol上述反应所得的化合物II，溶解在1000mL的环己烷中，然后在20-30℃温度条件下，半小时内加入含1.1mol(106.7g)1，3-环己二酮(化合物III)和1.8mol(291.6g)缩合剂CDI以及5mol(690g)碳酸钾，再在20-30℃温度条件下搅拌反应15小时，然后经过水洗、减压浓缩、加甲醇打浆、过滤、干燥得到成品环磺酮(化合物IV)355.5g，纯度96.3％，收率83.9％。
procedure_summary: Compound II from the preceding step was dissolved in cyclohexane, then the cyclohexanedione, the condensing agent CDI and potassium carbonate were added over a short period at the stated temperature and the mixture was stirred at that temperature. It was then washed with water, concentrated under reduced pressure, slurried with added methanol, filtered and dried to give tembotrione.
